summary: Describes SOCKS version 5, a protocol that lets a client connect through a firewall or proxy server. It supports pluggable authentication and is an evolution of version 4. It is on the standards track as a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: A friendly doorman who makes calls for you from inside a building. You tell him who you want to reach, and he connects you if you are allowed.
